title: Head-up display visibility and usefulness
summary: Feedback centers on the head-up display, with praise for its convenience and navigation display alongside complaints that it can be hard to see with sunglasses or intrusive in some viewing conditions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the head-up display for being useful and enjoyable, especially when showing navigation guidance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on poor visibility with sunglasses or polarized lenses, awkward positioning, and windshield interference during night driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention appreciation, desired availability, and feature limitations such as missing CarPlay directions without clearly expressing overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Nearly half of the reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence about overall sentiment from the examples alone.
The sampled fragments are not representative estimates, so they should not be used to infer broader prevalence beyond this topic sample.
Some undetermined fragments mix praise, preferences, and feature requests, which limits precise interpretation of customer satisfaction.
